title: # GitHub settings
intro: > Written by Buildorder, which never creates a repo, pushes or calls the GitHub API. Run these commands yourself
> from the workspace root, once the repo exists on GitHub and `main` is pushed. They need the GitHub CLI, logged in
> with admin rights on the repo (`gh auth status`).
noRemote: No GitHub remote yet: after the first push, replace `{{slug}}` with the repo's owner and name.
ruleset: - [ ] Ruleset on the default branch: pull requests only, no force push, no deletion, required check `{{check}}`
looseRuleset: - [ ] Ruleset on the default branch: pull requests only, no force push, no deletion (no required check yet:
the repo's CI has no `{{check}}` job)
requireLater: - [ ] Once `ci.yml` with the `{{check}}` job is on `main` (the gap task of the standard), require it: take the ruleset id from `gh api repos/{{slug}}/rulesets`, then
privateSecrets: - Secret scanning and push protection: left out, a private repo needs GitHub Advanced Security (Secret
Protection) for them; the gitleaks job in CI is the protection.
verify: - [ ] Check: `gh api repos/{{slug}}/rulesets` lists the ruleset `{{ruleset}}`.
outro: Private repos: rulesets need GitHub Pro or higher, secret scanning and push protection need GitHub Secret
Protection. Without them, the gitleaks job in CI is the protection.
